stable.headline: Edit mesh with points, edges and polygons, a keyboard in the shortcuts window with keys you can change, and a faster start.
notes: Edit mesh: points, edges and polygons, picked with Click, Box or Brush.
Move, delete, dissolve, weld, fill and extract what you picked.
The shortcuts window shows the keyboard, and every key can be changed.
Quick remesh on B, and Untriangulate clears points on straight lines.
A Scale switch in the Transform panel, and groups can be scaled.
